protocol.selection: Python random.Random(20261026).sample(sorted(all instructed test episode IDs with >=98 real frames),30); sorted selected IDs for processing; no outcome-based selection
protocol.timing: Three independent whole-rollout measurements per case, horizon and arm; average within trajectory first. Exclude text cache, model loading, scoring, file IO. Warm each arm/horizon in same process. Exclusive GPU use; no training overlap.
protocol.memory: Peak PyTorch allocated memory including model/codec/text residency; reserved separate; not full device memory.
protocol.shared_conditions: Same two initial real frames, real action prefixes and instruction; standalone generation at each horizon; no padding or GT refresh; windows exclude fixed dynamic anchor.
protocol.confidence: Paired 10000 trajectory bootstrap; timing repeats are not independent trajectories; one trained checkpoint.
protocol.scope: Thirty randomly selected long-eligible test trajectories shared by all five horizons. Findings apply to this long-eligible cohort, not the entire RT1 distribution.
